decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering, it only launched in 2024, and its development investment in a physical product is already sunk, so management will keep it and attribute slow uptake to long municipal procurement cycles.

The energy management system is central to the firm's publicly announced direction of digital networking, efficiency and energy recovery, so dropping it would contradict that strategy and write off software investment, and management will persist with it.
The overflow flap gate is a multi-model product line with its own dedicated web page, which signals substantial investment and visible public commitment, so management is very likely to keep it.
